verdict.rationale: Runway documents that a plan supports 20 parallel video and image generations. It also lets you run the same prompt across multiple models at once. Both give some ability to act on many items simultaneously, but neither is a documented bulk or batch operation feature. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API endpoint or UI for applying one action across many assets, bulk edit or delete of library items, and independent or hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
